bluesheetText:
Bluesheet for interim-2026-cbor-18
========================================================================

11 attendees.


Carsten Bormann	
Christian Amsüss	
Joe Hildebrand	
Barry Leiba	
Martine Lenders	
Marco Tiloca	
Laurence Lundblade	
Ira McDonald	
Вадим Гончаров	
Michael Richardson	
Rohan Mahy

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: are there audio or mine problems?

chat.author: Marco Tiloca
chat.text: Audio works fine for me

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: audio works well for me

chat.author: Christian Amsüss
chat.text: Reference mail on that topic was <https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/msg/cbor/qgMoc_0i0JY96Jj5m3alGBy0MsQ/>

chat.author: Christian Amsüss
chat.text: (for what it is worth; discussion has gone beyond it anyway)

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: I want to be able specify e.g. 200_ms translating to 1001(...) and this contradicts to "just ignore"

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: I also disagree with ABNF change, the main talk was about just "no IANA registry"

chat.author: Joe Hildebrand
chat.text: Is leading-plus valid in JSON?

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: sorry I'm late

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: We had a process. Let's stick to the process please

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: octal reason in -28 is good and I agree, but why leading + ?

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: complexity

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: leading + is harmless IMHO

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: no, leading plus is not valid in JSON

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: what is the need?

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: if we don't really need it, throw it out

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: more easy copy paste?

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: correct

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: and that was our process

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: i don't think anyone has demonstrated why strings are likely to have leading +

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: I have no strong opinion on "+" - it's bikeshed, don't waste time on it

chat.author: Joe Hildebrand
chat.text: they're saying that your technical reason wasn't good enough, and the chairs do get to decide that according to the process.

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: but as a general philosophy, Christian has a good quote in footer of message about narrowing future leads to traps

chat.author: Martine Lenders
chat.text:
Something like
[
   { "value": +1.0,
     "name": "x"},
   { "value": -0.9,
     "name": "y"}
]

could be something someone has for readability sake.

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: +1 Martine

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: I don't think we should have ever had comments in quoted strings. But having no time machine. Let's stick to only backwards-compatible comments in h'' and b64''

chat.author: Joe Hildebrand
chat.text: +1 rohan

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: our process is supposed to be about shipping the doc according to the process. not about adding NEW features

chat.author: Michael Richardson
chat.text: Are we in agreement that all options involve a non-backward compatible change?

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: (Define NBC)

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: What Carsten has proposed is non-backwards compatible

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: What Joe proposed is to remain backwards compatible

chat.author: Michael Richardson
chat.text: Are we hung-up on definition of NBC?  I thought everyone agreed that this was NBC: and so the feature should not be done if one wants to remain BC.

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: as I'm reading Paul's message, proposal was to delete from h'' but not entirely, so I'm fine with it

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: I don't think this was to move encoding indicators, I think it was to allow app-prefixes to include underscores.

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: fair enough

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: ambiguity was h'12'_2

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: That is not ambiguous

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: I still occasionally don't hear audio

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: We have 70 years of usability experience that humans can't quickly count past ~7

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: I believe Orie added support for this at some point

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: the support for _i in front was earlier months, I can make a mail with references if needed

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: thanks for proving my point Carsten. None of us can tell if there are the same number of opening and closing square brackets in your example visually.

chat.author: Michael Richardson
chat.text: I have to have code to return an error when I see more than 640K backtics, and malloc() fails.

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: lol

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: i'm confident we can get this right

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: That is similar to the encoding indicator extensibility issue

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: +1 to CA proposal "... is in grammar but left to implementer"

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: I don't understand why people want to remove extensibility from E DN

chat.author: Christian Amsüss
chat.text: :smile:

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: i don't think we ever had consensus for "CDN"

chat.author: Joe Hildebrand
chat.text: Let's not rathole on the name, but yeah, we're going to have to talk about it one day

chat.author: Barry Leiba
chat.text: The issue, Vadim, is to have extensions where they made sense, and not where we don't need them, regardless of the name.

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: leave both EI wordspec and ...

chat.author: Joe Hildebrand
chat.text: I have AOB

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: AOB?

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: I again don't hear Carsten and Barry

chat.author: Joe Hildebrand
chat.text: Any-Other-Business

chat.author: Christian Amsüss
chat.text: any-other-business; noting it down in the minutes so we get back to you

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: (I haven't read the -serialization upgrade yet.)

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: about float'' - I'm against the name, rename it and will be fine

chat.author: Michael Richardson
chat.text: what ... well. I can't seem to write it here.

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: science calculations may need more

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: just put into Security Considerations

chat.author: Laurence Lundblade
chat.text: 10K as a default is fine. Make it configurable.

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: thanks all

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: (renaming float'' is fine.)

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: Let's do that in the great renaming discussion.

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: The reason for the name was that it was implemented that way in multiple implementations.  That can be changed...
